title: Chicken saag with spinach
summary: Chicken saag with spinach is a indian dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chicken saag with spinach. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add skinless chicken thigh fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and baby spinach.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken saag with spinach before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chicken saag with spinach.
